audit.whatIsWrong: Both charts read Skill/Skill/Skill/Irelia/Skill/Irelia/Irelia while the packet chart reads Sett on rows 0-5 with Irelia only at 2+ items, and every one of this page's own whys[] rows 0-5 is written from Sett's side ('You bully a squishy, short-ranged Irelia', 'Level 3 E Facebreaker lets you stun her mid-dash', 'With a first item you brawl through a still-squishy Irelia').
audit.why: The win rate is 55.74% over 2815 games, the packet chart gives Sett every row up to two items, and the prose already agrees. Only the side tokens were wrong. No mirror exists yet, so this side sets the record; whoever audits irelia__sett must invert these ratings rather than re-derive them.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-5 flipped to Sett in both layers as one atomic group with ratings moved to match; row 6 stays Irelia, which the whys and the packet both support.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and the cooldown block listed the same ability twice — once as 'Flawless Duet (Stun)' and once as 'Flawless Duet' — with no numbers on either.
audit.why: Flawless Duet is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s at 850 range; Bladesurge is 10/9/8/7/6s and refreshes on a Marked or dying target, which is why denying reset minions matters; The Show Stopper is 120s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block rewritten with Flawless Duet's 16s and 850 range plus Bladesurge's 10s and its refund condition; Bladesurge's 6s at rank 5 keyed to the first-item phase and R's 120s to the level-6 spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three errors and one missing interaction. (a) 'Q slow' — Knuckle Down has no slow. (b) 'your W heals chunk her' — Haymaker grants a shield, not a heal. (c) Facebreaker is called a stun throughout with no mention that a lone target on one side is only slowed — decisive here, because a slow is exactly what Bladesurge undoes. And the page never states the best interaction in the lane: Defiant Dance reduces PHYSICAL damage during the charge, while Haymaker's centre is true damage.
audit.why: Riot's Sett Q text is empowered attacks plus move speed; the W text is 'gain a shield and punch an area, dealing true damage in the center and physical damage on the sides'; the E text makes the stun conditional on opposite sides. Riot's Irelia W text: 'She takes reduced physical damage during the charge' — so the edges of your panel are cut and the centre is not.
audit.corrected: Phantom Q slow and the phantom heal removed; the across-the-minions condition written into phases[2], spikes[0], mid and wants.you[0]; the centre-the-target-through-Defiant-Dance rule written into phases[3] and the first-item spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both applicable missing interactions were absent: Bladesurge heals her on every dash, and Vanguard's Edge leaves a wall that cuts the retreat of a champion with no dash.
audit.why: Sett has no mobility at all — his only escape is Flash. A player who spends Flash to dodge the R damage then walks into the wall it leaves behind has nothing left. And without Grievous Wounds, every Bladesurge refunds the chip you just paid for.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds written into phases[5] and the first-item spike with the reason attached; the wall-cuts-retreat rule into phases[6] and the late text. The itemization row already recommended Executioner's Calling but called Irelia 'his' — pronoun fixed.

edits.before: When Irelia Q Bladesurges a minion to close, that's your window — E Facebreaker to stun her mid-dash, Q slow, and W the empowered haymaker before her passive stacks build.
edits.after: When Irelia Bladesurges in, that's your window — pull her across your wave so Facebreaker stuns instead of slowing, then punch twice and cash Haymaker before her stacks build.

edits.after: The Show Stopper (120s) carries her off her own wave, and with no minion to Bladesurge she cannot reset out — commit once her Q (10s at rank 1) is spent.

edits.after: With a bruiser item you brawl through her, but Defiant Dance cuts physical damage — centre her in the Haymaker panel for the true damage, and buy Grievous Wounds for her Q heals.

edits.after: Irelia out-scales you if she snowballs — Vanguard's Edge stuns, then leaves a wall you have no dash through, so keep her even in lane and burst her before her items land.

notes: No mirror existed for this matchup, so this side sets the record: the irelia__sett page must be the inverse of this chart (Irelia loses rows 0-5, wins 2+ items), not a fresh derivation. The best fact in this lane was missing entirely and is now stated: Defiant Dance reduces physical damage while she charges, and Haymaker's centre is true damage — so standing her dead-centre in the panel is the difference between a cut trade and a full one. The full layer's focus.text, tldr, loading and every dos/donts row use the invented short form 'Flawless Duet (Stun)' rather than the real name Flawless Duet; the cooldown block is fixed here, but the rest need one coordinated rename. Also flagged: the page headline says 'build armor', which is reasonable against her physical damage but sits oddly beside 'deny Q targets' as the same instruction — Grievous Wounds is the buy the kit actually argues for, and it is now in the first-item text.
